profile.headline: Software Engineer at CloudNAV
profile.summary:
My career has spanned the many aspects of the software engineering process. I have done software development, test development, QA, code documentation, technical writing, SDK writing, benchmarking, process development, and training but my passion at work has come to be centered around how all the various disciplines work together as a system, improving those processes, and fostering a highly collaborative working environment. 

I am just completing training through the University of Washington in project management so that I can focus my work on the process of producing great software and workplace processes that are enjoyable, efficient, and productive for the people working in them. I am looking forward to moving into the next phase of my career. 

In my free time, I create digital art, write fantasy novels, cook a lot, dance, and try my best to enjoy life to its fullest.

positions.title: Principle Software Engineer
positions.description:
Own the design and implementation of software applications for complex medtech sensor visualization, the primary interface for clinicians and operators to interpret real-time data from CloudNAV's sensor fusion platform. Built in C++ using Qt and VTK.

Design, develop, and maintain the core applications that serve as integration points between software, hardware, and algorithm teams. Work directly with the company's Distinguished Engineer and co-founder on architectural direction, technology vetting, and platform investment priorities.

Designed, built, and maintain a multi-feature test application used daily by algorithm and hardware teams. Core internal infrastructure for validating and developing on the sensor fusion platform.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Embedded software engineer within the Product Management organization, building tools and applications to address a wide range of internal and customer-facing needs: data center integration tooling, test suite management software, and hardware configuration interfaces.

Solely designed, developed, and tested the iApp Templates, a library of GUI-driven automation tools that simplified setup and integration of F5 load-balancing hardware and software. The iApp Templates were cited at an all-company meeting as a major contributor to a $20M quarterly sales increase and were considered one of F5's most successful product initiatives of the period.

positions.title: Lead Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)
positions.description: Led a 5-person SDET team responsible for test infrastructure for the embedded media processor firmware powering the Apple iPod. Designed and built the test harness from scratch, establishing test processes and release criteria used across the organization. Served as build master and primary root-cause analyst for hardware/software integration failures.

positions.title: Software Developer II
positions.description: Designed, developed, and deployed an web-based software solution in Java and JSP

positions.title: Software Engineer in Test Development
positions.description:
Wrote and developed all tests plans.
Wrote and operated tests and test tool software for multiple targets of firmware for an IEEE1394 FireWire system.
Performed Linux Compatibility testing for the IEEE1394 system.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked as C++ Developer on a team of 5 developing an e-commerce solution.
Produced and developed documentation
Wrote functional specifications for major features of the product and developed those features in C++ and SQL Wrote and implemented test plans.
